get.summary: Whether the instance is answering, and which build it is.
The licence and notice of every third-party package this instance includes, generated and gated by `check:notices`.
Where the exact source of the running build is — the offer AGPL-3.0 §13 requires (ADR 0036 D-6).
What another rider may see of an athlete: the display name, and nothing else.

post.summary: A single-use nonce, good for 60 seconds, for a device to sign with its key. Rate-limited per key and per address.

get.summary: This athlete’s device keys: when each was added and last used, and which is asking.

post.summary: Revoke one of this athlete’s device keys and its sessions. The last key needs one of the athlete’s recovery codes, which is checked and not spent.
Change the display name: 1–32 characters, no control, bidirectional or invisible character. Rate-limited, and the old name is kept for moderation.
Add this device’s key to the athlete whose other device minted the code, with a signed `oyl-link-v1` statement.

401.description: One of `wrong_purpose`, `wrong_instance`, `challenge_unknown`, `challenge_used`, `challenge_expired`, `bad_signature`, `code_unknown`, `code_used`, `code_expired`, in the one error shape.

post.summary: A single-use code, good for 5 minutes, that adds another device’s own key to this athlete.
Add this device’s key to an athlete with a recovery code, or with an emailed token where the operator enabled email recovery, and a signed `oyl-recover-v1` statement.

401.description: One of `wrong_purpose`, `wrong_instance`, `challenge_unknown`, `challenge_used`, `challenge_expired`, `bad_signature`, `code_unknown`, `code_used`, `code_expired`, in the one error shape.

post.summary: Email a single-use recovery link to an address, if an athlete registered it. The same answer either way. `not_found` where the operator has not enabled email recovery.
Sign in with a signed `oyl-auth-v1` statement. A key the instance has not seen registers a new athlete, and only then are the recovery codes in the answer.

401.description: One of `wrong_purpose`, `wrong_instance`, `challenge_unknown`, `challenge_used`, `challenge_expired`, `bad_signature`, `key_revoked`, in the one error shape.

get.summary: Who this session is: the athlete, as other riders see them.

delete.summary: Sign out: the session is revoked on the instance, not only forgotten by the device.

get.summary: The athletes this athlete has blocked.

post.summary: Block an athlete: neither of you sees or reaches the other, whoever blocked whom. Answers the same whether or not the athlete exists.

delete.summary: Remove a block this athlete made. Answers the same whether or not there was one.

post.summary: Hide an athlete’s display name from other riders until they choose another. Written to the moderation log.
Suspend an account: every one of its keys is refused, its sessions end, and other riders stop seeing it. Nothing it owns is deleted. Written to the moderation log.
Lift a suspension. Written to the moderation log.

get.summary: Every moderator action, oldest first. Append-only.
The moderators’ queue: every report not yet decided, oldest first.

post.summary: Dismiss a report, with a reason. Written to the moderation log.
Report an athlete to this instance’s moderators, with a reason. Rate-limited per reporter. Answers the same whether or not the athlete exists.
A ticket for one room’s WebSocket hello: single use, 30 seconds. The socket never carries the session token.

session.description: A session token from `POST /v1/auth/session`. Never a WebSocket credential: a room takes a ticket.
